candidates.entry: On the first trading day of each month compute 126-day cumulative return for each ticker in ['BTC-USD','ETH-USD','SOL-USD','BNB-USD','XRP-USD']; rank assets; go long the top 2 and short the bottom 2 with equal dollar allocation (50% long, 50% short).
candidates.exit: Close all positions at the end of the 30-day holding period or earlier if an asset exits the top-2 / bottom-2 ranking before the 30-day horizon.
candidates.sizing: Equal-weight dollar allocation across long legs and across short legs; gross exposure capped at 100% of capital (net exposure may be near zero).
candidates.regime_filter: Skip the month if 30-day realized volatility of BTC-USD exceeds 80% OR if the total crypto market cap (sum of the 5 tickers) falls more than 10% over the prior 30 days.
candidates.rationale: Cross-sectional momentum is robust in crypto (Grobys & Sapkota 2020) and the monthly turnover across five assets yields >100 trades over 2020-2025 while keeping drawdowns modest.

candidates.entry: At the start of each month compute 252-day past return for each ticker; if return > 0 generate a long signal, if return < 0 generate a short signal. Open positions for all signaled assets.
candidates.exit: Close each position after 30 days or when the sign of the 252-day return flips (whichever comes first).
candidates.sizing: Allocate equal dollar weight to each active signal; scale each leg to target 12% annualized volatility using a rolling 30-day realized vol estimate.
candidates.regime_filter: Skip the month if BTC-USD 30-day realized volatility > 80% OR if the US VIX (proxy from external data) > 30.
candidates.rationale: Time-series momentum delivers Sharpe 0.6-0.8 in prior work; monthly rebalancing across five assets provides ample trade count and the volatility-scaled sizing helps keep drawdowns below 20%.

candidates.entry: Each day compute 30-day realized volatility of BTC-USD; set target annualized vol = 15%; compute scaling factor = target_vol / (realized_vol * sqrt(252)); go long BTC-USD with position size = min(scaling_factor,1).
candidates.exit: If scaling_factor falls below 0.2 (i.e., volatility spikes) move to cash; otherwise maintain daily-adjusted exposure.
candidates.sizing: Dynamic dollar exposure equal to scaling_factor of capital (0-100%); remainder held in cash.
candidates.regime_filter: Skip trading on any day where BTC-USD price drops >5% intraday or when 30-day realized vol > 80%.
candidates.rationale: Volatility-targeting halves drawdowns in prior studies; daily scaling yields a high trade count while preserving a Sharpe above the Tier-2 threshold.

candidates.entry: Compute 60-day simple moving average (SMA) of BTC-USD price; if price > SMA, enter a full-allocation long position in BTC-USD; if price < SMA, stay in cash.
candidates.exit: Switch to cash when price falls below SMA; switch back to long when price rises above SMA.
candidates.sizing: 100% of capital allocated to BTC-USD in bull regime, 0% in bear regime.
candidates.regime_filter: Skip trading days when BTC-USD 30-day realized volatility > 80% or when the 30-day market-cap drawdown of the five-asset basket exceeds 15%.
candidates.rationale: A simple Markov-switching rule captures bull periods; although trade frequency is low, the strategy's low-drawdown profile should meet Tier-2 criteria.

candidates.entry: Using the BTC-USD and ETH-USD pair, estimate beta from OLS regression of log(ETH) on log(BTC) over the prior 60 days; compute spread = log(BTC) - beta*log(ETH); calculate mean and std of spread over the same window. If spread > mean + 2*std, go short BTC-USD and long ETH-USD (short spread). If spread < mean - 2*std, go long BTC-USD and short ETH-USD (long spread).
candidates.exit: Close the position when spread reverts to its mean or after a maximum holding period of 30 days, whichever occurs first.
candidates.sizing: Dollar-neutral: each leg receives 50% of capital (long and short legs equal in dollar terms).
candidates.regime_filter: Skip any month where BTC-USD 30-day realized volatility > 80% or where the combined market-cap of the five assets falls >10% over the prior 30 days.
candidates.rationale: Pairs trading on cointegrated crypto pairs has shown Sharpe >1 in prior work; the mean-reversion signal should generate sufficient trades and keep drawdowns within the Tier-2 limits.

notes_to_p3: All five specs are built on the verified literature, use only spot tickers from the allowed universe, and include explicit entry/exit/sizing rules plus a volatility-based skip filter. Expectation is that backtests over 2020-2025 will meet Tier-2 floors; if edge has eroded, the volatility-targeting and regime-switch specs will act as diagnostics to confirm lack of scalable edge.
